title: MZ [Solved] Pushing a cart along a track

posts.author: MegaGothmog
posts.body:
I want to push a cart along a track.
But this track has curves and corners in it, so I can't just have it be pushed forward 3 times and call it a day.
I would like to push the cart, lets say, 3 tiles forward, but if the track goes left, the cart follows it.
How would I go about doing this?

posts.author: fizzly
posts.body: Just use the movement route and set is as trail goes?

posts.author: MegaGothmog
posts.body:
fizzly said:
Just use the movement route and set is as trail goes?
Click to expand...
That can work, but only when the cart is in a predetermined location, but I'd like a bit more freedom.
What I'm looking for is when I push the cart 3 tiles forward.. it goes 3 tiles forward.
But if there is a bend in the track.. it follows that. But there won't be a bend or curve in the track each time I push.
On the picture. I can push the cart along the track according to a Movement Route.. sure.
But I want to be able to push the cart 1,2 or 3 tiles forward.
After pushing it forward, I'll have to push it again, and again, until it reaches the end of the track, by having it automatically follow the track as it goes left or right.
Then the Movement Route-method won't work anymore... as far as I know... since that one relies on a fixed origin-location.
Plus I'd like there to be triggers along the way that only get triggered when the cart stops on that location... but that I should be able to do...I hope
Sorry, I should have been more clear

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
you can use a stopper or set an event, so you cannot push forward.
so you can change page (so it can go left only or right).
better way is to use region on the corner, if the event is on region 4.
you can only push left, if 2, only down etc.
there are multiple ways to achieve it, but choose the way you like.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
If it always moves 3, you can just make predefined move routes, like save the position in a variable or something. If you can choose to move it different amounts, you could use 'get location info: tile id' event command to check where the rail tile is and make it move in that direction.
EDIT: And yeah you need like conditionals so it doesn't check the tile that's behind it
EDIT2: Yeah or use regions to restrict it, like said above. I just always want reasons to use those odd commands.

posts.author: MegaGothmog
posts.body:
I was indeed thinking about using a region tile on the corner.
It seems like that is the way to go
Thanks for the suggestions!

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
if you want full freedom of movement, one way to do this needs three or for different region numbers.
basically place the region numbers along the track with the number telling a direction.
then have the cart event use get location info to read the region ID, check it with several conditional branches and set different move routes depending on the region.
that will allow the cart to steer along the track no matter how it turns around.

posts.author: pawsplay
posts.body: I think I would do this with passability. You can set a variable to three and get the location of the event. Then order the event to move. If it now finds itself on a different tile, decrement it by 1. Otherwise, try moving to the left. If that doesn't work, try the right. Then start the routine over again, until the counter reaches 0.

posts.author: Axgin96
posts.body:
Thanks
@fizzly
for the mention!
I’ve created a plugin that allows minecarts (or any other event) to move along a predefined route, drawn using
Region ID 7
(which you can change via script if needed).
How it works:​
Just use this in a
Script Call
:
KartRide.toggle(eventId, [x1, y1], [x2, y2]);
eventId: the event ID of the cart. Only one event is needed—it disappears at the starting point and reappears at the destination.
[x1, y1]: coordinates of the first endpoint
[x2, y2]: coordinates of the second endpoint
You can download the plugin here:
https://axgin96.itch.io/minecart-ride
How to use it:​
Draw the route using
Region ID 7
between the two points you want the cart to travel.
This event is designed so the
player can ride the cart
along the defined path.
Tips:​
Since the cart event is automatically
moved and hidden
at departure, and then reappears at the destination, I recommend:
Activating a
Self Switch
when the player interacts with the cart.
Creating a
second event page
with no image, triggered by that Self Switch.
Once the ride ends,
turn off the Self Switch
so the cart reappears in the final position.
If you have
followers enabled
, it might be a good idea to
temporarily hide them
during the ride. Otherwise, they’ll try to follow the player on foot, which can break immersion.
I’m not a pro developer, but I’m working to polish and optimize the plugin as much as I can.
Any feedback or suggestions are always welcome!
